As a Revenue Operations Analyst you will be a key member of our Revenue Operations team' Deal Desk Processes. You will be responsible for driving operational excellence across the deal lifecycle. You will partner closely with Sales, Legal, Finance, Cybersecurity and Product teams to ensure deals are structured effectively, priced accurately, and executed efficiently in alignment with company policies and revenue goals.

You will be responsible for managing the end-to-end quote-to-close process, supporting complex deal structuring, and ensuring compliance with commercial terms and revenue recognition policies. This role requires a balance of analytical skills, process discipline, and business acumen to enable the commercial unit to close deals faster and with higher quality.
In line with Saudization requirements, we are currently prioritizing Saudi national candidates for this position.
q: Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Engineering, or any related field.
2+ years of experience in sales operations, revenue operations, sales support, or a similar role.
Excellent analytical and communication skills, with the ability to balance strategic thinking and attention to detail.
Experience with CRM platforms (Salesforce) as well as contract management tools.
Strong understanding of different business models, pricing structures, and revenue recognition principles.
Experience working in SaaS or technology companies.
Highly organized with great attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines.
Strong understanding of sales processes and metrics, with the ability to optimize and improve processes.
Must be fluent in both written and spoken English and Arabic.
